author: Pavel Durov
text: ⛔️  The UK government wants to ban social media for children under 16. But banning social media for kids only puts them in greater danger. They will be pushed to use VPNs — and unlock far worse illegal content. We’ve seen this before. When the Russian government banned Telegram, 95% of Russian teenagers kept using it. They just moved to VPNs. Same in Iran. Parents already have the tools to restrict their kids’ digital habits: parental controls, screen-time limits — or no smartphone at all. 🤦‍♂️

text: 🚫  India’s IT ministry banned Telegram for one week because some users shared leaked exam questions. The leaks just moved to other apps. 🛡  We’ve done a lot to help fix the problem — even though its source is not Telegram. text: 💎  Telegram has applied for the  .gram  domain zone. author: Pavel Durov
text: 💸  In just one month, Telegram has awarded over  $2,222,000  to some of the brightest minds on our planet. 🎨  This week alone we distributed  $222,000  among the winners of our two latest competitions — the  Design Contest  and the  Digital Freedom Contest . On top of that, over the past month we awarded prizes  worth more  than  $2 million  to the winners of the 2026 International Olympiads in  Informatics  and  AI . We're proud to support the best!  🎁

text: 🤝  Telegram has become the sponsor of  Codeforces  — the largest competitive programming platform in the world.    ⚡ CodeForces organizes over  100  coding contests every year and has  4 million  contestants signed up. 🌱  Since 2010, I've supported Codeforces through the companies I started. 🆙  But this year will be special.
